step.name: call_pickup_place
step.content: {"order":"CD-420458","goal":"Tell Calverona the gig stays unpublished and no driver will come until the seller's signed release arrives at werkstatt@calverona.example; ask them to tell us when it arrives and whether the seller hold is lifted.","language":"de"}

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Calverona Hamburg, Werkstatt, Lukas Brandt am Apparat. Was kann ich für Sie tun?
turns.translation: Calverona Hamburg, workshop, Lukas Brandt speaking. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Guten Tag Herr Brandt, hier ist der digitale Assistent von Bahn, es geht um den Ferrari Roma, Auftrag CD-420458. Wir veröffentlichen den Auftrag erst und schicken keinen Fahrer, bis die unterschriebene Freigabe des Verkäufers bei werkstatt@calverona.example eingeht. Können Sie uns Bescheid geben, wenn sie da ist und ob die Sperre des Verkäufers aufgehoben ist?
turns.translation: Hello Mr. Brandt, this is Bahn's digital assistant, regarding the Ferrari Roma, order CD-420458. We will only publish the order and send a driver once the seller's signed release arrives at werkstatt@calverona.example. Could you let us know when it has arrived and whether the seller's hold is lifted?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Gut, dass Sie noch keinen Fahrer schicken. Für den Ferrari ist bei der Werkstatt keine Freigabe angekommen, und der Verkäufer hat ihn wegen der offenen Rechnung gesperrt. Ob ich Ihnen Bescheid geben kann, müsste ich erst klären.
turns.translation: Good that you're not sending a driver yet. No release has reached the workshop for the Ferrari, and the seller has put a hold on it because of the unpaid invoice. Whether I can notify you, I'd have to check first.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alles klar, danke. Wenn Sie das geklärt haben, schreiben Sie uns bitte kurz, sobald die Freigabe da ist und die Sperre aufgehoben wurde. Bis dahin kommt kein Fahrer.
turns.translation: Alright, thanks. Once you've clarified that, please send us a short message as soon as the release has arrived and the hold is lifted. Until then, no driver will come.

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Verstanden, ich muss das intern klären, ob wir Ihnen Bescheid geben können. Bis die Sperre aufgehoben ist und die Freigabe per E-Mail an werkstatt@calverona.example da ist, geben wir den Wagen nicht heraus. Schönen Tag noch, auf Wiederhören.
turns.translation: Understood, I'd have to check internally whether we can notify you. Until the hold is lifted and the release has arrived by e-mail at werkstatt@calverona.example, we won't hand the car over. Have a nice day, goodbye.

steps.name: resolve_without_person

steps.content:
I called Calverona Hamburg (Lukas Brandt) and told them the gig stays unpublished. No driver comes until the seller's signed release reaches werkstatt@calverona.example. Brandt confirmed that no release has arrived and that the seller has put a hold on the car over an unpaid invoice. Calverona won't hand the car over until both are resolved. He said he must check internally whether they can notify Bahn.

I resolved the order with Aino's pause_gig option and no changes. I scheduled a callback for 09:00 Hamburg time on 22 October to ask whether the release is in and the hold is lifted.

decision.why: The customer already knows and is chasing the seller, so a second message only adds noise. Keep the gig unpublished until the release is in.

lesson.text: Calverona Hamburg: when the seller has put a hold on the car, Aino did not take the suggestion and chose to keep the gig unpublished and wait for the customer to bring the release because the customer already knows and is chasing the seller, so a second message only adds noise. Keep the gig unpublished until the release is in.
